children: Modelon, a leader in cloud-native, AI-driven system simulation software, invites current and new investors to a Capital Markets Day, held at Redeye in Stockholm. It will be possible to participate both on-site or through a live broadcast.
The event will give a more thorough understanding of Modelon’s growth opportunities and business models in the growing simulation market. Focus of the presentations will be on:
Market trends and opportunities, based on testimonials from customers and partners.
Product innovation in AI-driven system simulation, for radically increased customer productivity,
Application-specific packages with simulation libraries and AI skills, for trusted simulation models and digital twins.
New business models and revenue opportunities, driven by adoption of AI and cloud-based simulation.
Those who wish to participate in the event can register their interest through https://www.lyyti.in/Capital_Markets_Day_Modelon.

CEO Jan Häglund together with the Modelon management team, will present on November 10, 2026, at 13:00 – 15:00 CET. The event will be held in English and will be made available at www.modelon.com. The live presentation as well as a recording will be available via the link below:

Modelon provides systems modeling and simulation software that accelerates product innovation, development and operations in a range of industries. Modelon’s flagship product, Modelon Impact, is a cloud-native, AI-driven system simulation software platform featuring a collaborative browser-based interface and thousands of proven models and components spanning a broad range of applications. Headquartered in Lund, Sweden, and with global reach, Modelon is an expert industry leader in model-based systems engineering with a focus on leveraging open standard technologies.
Modelon AB is listed on Nasdaq First North Growth Market with ticker symbol MODEL. Redeye Nordic Growth AB is appointed the Company’s Certified Adviser.
